runners.name: Meyn
runners.funFact: Runs faster when his favorite playlist is on
runners.bio: The natural athlete of the group. Started running to destress and discovered a hidden talent for speed. Always the first to finish intervals.

runners.name: Harun
runners.funFact: Has never skipped a single scheduled training run
runners.bio: The most consistent runner in the team. What he lacks in raw speed, he makes up with iron discipline and an unbreakable routine.

runners.name: Nazif
runners.funFact: Signed up for the half marathon on a dare — now fully committed
runners.bio: The newest runner of the trio. Improving at an insane rate and brings the most energy and heart to every session.
